sahneler.gorsel: Close-up of a man's hand holding a fountain pen over a contract on a dark wooden office desk, a second signature being copied from another paper, desk lamp light.
sahneler.hareket: The pen moves slowly over the paper, the hand hesitates, slow push-in

sahneler.gorsel: Wide shot inside a dim 1980s Istanbul office: the door at the back opens, hard white light behind, silhouette of a broad-shouldered Turkish man in his sixties, thick black moustache, no beard, long black wool overcoat, black flat cap, his face half hidden in deep shadow standing in the doorway, people in foreground turning their heads.
sahneler.hareket: The door swings open, light floods in, the silhouetted man stands still, the people turn their heads, slow push-in

sahneler.gorsel: Low angle shot of a broad-shouldered Turkish man in his sixties, thick black moustache, no beard, long black wool overcoat, black flat cap, his face half hidden in deep shadow, walking slowly toward camera through a dim office, backlit, dust in the air.
sahneler.hareket: The man walks slowly and heavily toward the camera, overcoat moving, steady tracking shot

sahneler.gorsel: Extreme close-up of a large weathered male hand with a silver ring pressing flat on a contract on a wooden desk, a fountain pen rolling away.
sahneler.hareket: The large hand presses down firmly, the pen rolls slowly away, shallow focus

sahneler.gorsel: Inside view: a nervous man in a suit leaves through the office door toward a sunlit Istanbul street, a broad-shouldered Turkish man in his sixties, thick black moustache, no beard, long black wool overcoat, black flat cap, his face half hidden in deep shadow stands beside the door, seen from behind.
sahneler.hareket: The man walks out slowly into the daylight, the older man stays still, slow pull-back
